title: Dream Big: MongoDB Launch Experience
summary: A MongoDB product launch experience connecting the venue, technical presentations, and supporting creative.
overview: I directed the brand and creative for MongoDB's Dream Big launch experience in San Francisco. Working with technical presenters, marketing partners, and production teams, I connected the product story across the venue and presentation design.

projectBrief.context: MongoDB's Dream Big event introduced a product story to a live audience in San Francisco.
projectBrief.challenge: The technical narrative needed to stay clear and engaging as it moved between the physical environment and on-stage presentation.
projectBrief.contribution: I directed the event brand and creative, working with technical presenters, marketing partners, and production teams.
projectBrief.approach: I aligned environmental graphics, stage presentation design, and supporting launch assets around one visual and narrative direction.
projectBrief.outcome: The event delivered a connected launch experience across the venue, technical presentation, and supporting creative.
